page.title: Privacy Policy
page.intro: This panel ("ArkManiaGest") is the management and player portal for an ARK: Survival Ascended game cluster. This notice explains, as required by Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), which personal data the panel processes, why, for how long, and which rights you can exercise.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.body: The data controller is the operator of the game cluster this panel belongs to. You can reach the operator through the community's Discord server or the contact channel published on the community website.

data.title: 2. What data we process
data.body:
Panel accounts (admins/operators): username, display name, a bcrypt hash of the password (never the password itself), role and last-login time.

Discord sign-in: your Discord user ID, username, display name and avatar hash, plus the OAuth access/refresh tokens Discord issues — stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM) and used only to read your basic profile ("identify" scope; we never request your e-mail).

Game link: the EOS player ID of your ARK character and the in-game data already recorded by the game servers (character name, tribe, permission groups, shop points, leaderboard scores, session login times).

Technical data: the source IP address of requests, used in-memory for rate limiting and recorded in the security audit log for login attempts and administrative actions. Game servers also record the IP you connect from while you are online.

purposes.title: 3. Purposes and legal bases
purposes.body:
Operating the panel and the player dashboard you request (performance of the service — Art. 6(1)(b)).

Security: rate limiting, brute-force protection, and an audit trail of logins and administrative actions (legitimate interest in protecting the service — Art. 6(1)(f), and compliance with security obligations such as the NIS2 directive).

Discord sign-in happens only when you choose it and approve Discord's consent screen (Art. 6(1)(a)). No data is used for advertising, profiling or analytics, and nothing is shared with third parties other than Discord itself during the sign-in flow.

retention.title: 4. Retention
retention.body:
Discord session: 24 hours (cookie lifetime).

Discord profile and OAuth tokens: until you delete your account from the dashboard (or an admin unlinks it).

Security audit log and server action history: deleted automatically after 365 days (configurable by the operator).

Rate-limiting IP tracking: held in memory only, for minutes.

Game data (characters, tribes, scores) follows the game servers' own lifecycle (e.g. wipes) and is not retained by the panel itself.

rights.title: 5. Your rights
rights.body:
You can access and export the data the panel stores about you at any time from your player dashboard ("Export my data" — Art. 15/20) and erase your Discord account data with "Delete my account" (Art. 17).

For rectification, restriction, objection, or anything the self-service tools don't cover, contact the operator (Section 1). You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority (in Italy, the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali).

cookies.title: 6. Cookies and local storage
cookies.body:
The panel uses only strictly necessary cookies: "disc_oauth_state" (10 minutes, protects the Discord sign-in against CSRF) and "disc_session" (24 hours, keeps you signed in). Both are HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Lax.

The browser additionally stores your interface preferences (theme, language) in localStorage and the admin session token in sessionStorage (cleared when the tab closes). No tracking, advertising or analytics cookies are used, so no cookie consent banner is required under the ePrivacy rules.

decay.scheduleTitle: Queue this tribe in ARKM_decay_pending; the next plugin purge sweep destroys it.
decay.confirmSchedule:
Schedule tribe #{{id}} ({{name}}) for destruction on every server?

The panel only stages the request; the plugin's next periodic sweep destroys all of the tribe's structures and dinos. Use 'Cancel' from the Pending tab to revert before the sweep runs.
decay.purgeNowTitle: Schedule this tribe AND immediately fire ARKM.DM.Purge over RCON on every active instance.
decay.confirmPurgeNow:
Purge tribe #{{id}} ({{name}}) RIGHT NOW?

The panel will: 1) insert the tribe into ARKM_decay_pending on every server, then 2) send ARKM.DM.Purge over RCON to every active ARK instance.
The plugin destroys all of the tribe's structures and dinos and writes the audit log entries.

This cannot be undone.
decay.purgeNowDone: Tribe #{{id}} purged: queued on {{rows}} server(s), RCON ok on {{ok}}/{{total}} instances.
decay.runPurgeTitle: Send ARKM.DM.Purge over RCON to every active ARK instance now.
decay.confirmRunPurge:
Run ARKM.DM.Purge on every active ARK instance NOW?

This triggers the plugin's purge sweep on each contacted server: every tribe currently listed in ARKM_decay_pending gets its structures + dinos destroyed.

This cannot be undone.
decay.cancelTitle: Remove this tribe from the pending purge queue (the decay timer keeps ticking)
decay.confirmCancel:
Cancel pending purge for tribe #{{id}} ({{name}}) on {{server}}?

The row in ARKM_decay_pending is removed; the tribe stays in ARKM_tribe_decay and the regular decay timer continues.

delete.title: Delete instance {{name}}?
delete.purge: Also stop the container on the host
delete.purgeHint: Runs a stop on the host before the panel record is removed. Leave it off to remove only the record; the files on the host are never deleted.

instances.restartCancelled: The scheduled restart of {{name}} was cancelled.
instances.restartScheduled: The restart runs in {{count}} minute(s). Players are being warned in game. Cancel it from here if it was a mistake.

discord.title: Discord
discord.subtitle: Manage Discord accounts, ARK player links and bot interactions.

settings.restartHint: Pydantic loads .env at boot -- restart the service to activate the changes:

hint.redirectUri: Must match EXACTLY the URI registered on the Discord Developer Portal -> OAuth2 -> Redirects.
hint.guildId: Right-click the server name on Discord (with Developer Mode enabled) -> Copy Server ID.
hint.vipRoleId: Discord snowflake of the role mirrored from the ARK plugin DB.  Right-click the role -> Copy Role ID (Developer Mode required).

secret.placeholder: Leave empty to keep current value

settings.confirmClearBody: {{fields}} will be emptied in .env. The panel cannot show the old value again, so it has to be pasted back from Discord.
settings.discardBody: The form goes back to the values loaded from the server.
settings.refreshBody: Reloading reads the values from the server again and drops the unsaved edits.
settings.leaveBody: Switching tab closes this form and the edits are lost.

errors.guildProbe: Bot credentials are set but Discord rejected the guild lookup.

hint.redirectMissing: Set DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI in .env and restart the service.
hint.redirectRegister: This URI must be registered EXACTLY in Discord Developer Portal -> OAuth2 -> Redirects.
hint.vipRoleMissing: Set DISCORD_VIP_ROLE_ID in .env and restart the service.

config.whitelistsExplain: Discord IDs listed here are auto-promoted to the matching role at first Sign-in with Discord (a 'discord:<id>' AppUser is created automatically).  The explicit Accounts -> Link AppUser flow always wins over a whitelist.
config.whitelistsEditHint: To change a whitelist: edit /opt/arkmaniagest/backend/.env and run 'systemctl restart arkmaniagest'.

vipSync.explain: Manual reconciliation.  Reads the VIP permission group (permanent OR active timed) from the plugin DB for every linked player and mirrors it onto the configured Discord role.  Players outside the link mapping are reported but never touched.
vipSync.strangerVips: Discord members with VIP role but no EOS link ({{n}})
vipSync.confirmBody: Every linked player's VIP status is read from the plugin database and mirrored onto the Discord role. Roles are assigned and removed on Discord straight away.
vipSync.scanFailed: Guild member scan failed, the stranger VIP list is incomplete: {{error}}
vipSync.scanCapped: Guild member scan stopped at its limit, the stranger VIP list is partial

errors.required: Select a Discord role AND type the ARK group name.

roleMap.title: Role sync (Discord -> ARK)
roleMap.explain: Each rule says: whoever has Discord role X receives permission group Y in the plugin DB (Players.PermissionGroups).  The sync engine does NOT touch groups not managed by active rules: the VIP sync (env DISCORD_VIP_ROLE_ID) and admin/custom groups pass through untouched.
roleMap.empty: No rules configured.  Add one below.
roleMap.confirmDeleteBody: {{role}} will no longer grant the ARK group {{group}}. Groups already applied to players are left in place.
roleMap.confirmSyncBody: Every linked player's ARK permission groups are rewritten to match their Discord roles. Groups are added and removed in the plugin database straight away.

members.empty: No members visible.  Make sure the bot has the GUILD_MEMBERS privileged intent enabled in the Discord Developer Portal.

modal.dmPh: Plain text only.  Markdown is supported.
modal.reasonPh: e.g. spam, raid, violation of server rules
modal.banWarning: A ban keeps the user out of the guild until it is lifted on Discord.

members.confirmRemoveRoleBody: {{role}} is taken off {{user}} on Discord straight away. If it is the VIP role, the next sync may put it back.

accounts.empty: No Discord accounts yet — ask an operator to Sign in with Discord at least once.

modal.search: Search by name, EOS or tribe

errors.loadShop: Failed to load the shop catalogue.

market.bought: Purchased! New balance: {{b}}. Use /market claim in-game to collect it.
market.confirmCancel: Cancel the listing?  The item will return to you via /market claim in-game.
market.cancelled: Cancelled. Use /market claim in-game to get it back.
market.title: Player market
market.subtitle: Buy, sell and manage your ARK items.
market.noMine: You have no items on the market.  Use /market upload in-game to add one.

shop.bought: Purchased. {{spent}} points spent — collect it in game with /ritiro.
shop.emptyItems: The shop is empty. An admin has to import the ArkShop catalogue first.
shop.emptyGenes: No gene traits published yet: they appear once a server boots with GeneShop 5.8.0+.
shop.geneHint: A gene arrives as a Gene Scanner with the trait already stored inside. Claim it in game with /ritiro, then use it like any scanner to apply the trait to a creature.
shop.pendingHint: You have {{n}} purchase(s) waiting: type /ritiro in game to collect them.
shop.claimHint: Purchases are collected in game with /ritiro.
shop.importHint: Fill the web window from the ArkShop config. Entries already there keep their price and visibility.
shop.noPriceSet: No price set for this tier.

forge.embryoHint: For gestating species (mammals): implants like an extracted embryo.
forge.claimHint: The egg/embryo arrives via /ritiro in game: the baby hatches with the stats, mutations, colors and traits chosen here.
forge.levelNote: Fixed level {{lvl}}: wild stats are rolled randomly by the server, like in the wild.
forge.emptyList: No species on sale right now.

prices.geneHint: Empty cell = price published by the plugin (shown as placeholder). Values entered here override the price list for every trait of the category and survive server reboots.
prices.noCats: No categories: the GeneShop has not published the trait catalog yet.
prices.forgeHint: Only listed (and enabled) species can be bought. The price is per species: the egg hatches at a fixed level with random stats.
prices.noSpecies: Empty list: add the species you want to sell.
prices.readOnly: Read-only: changing prices needs the operator role.

buyModal.title: Confirm purchase
buyModal.insufficient: Not enough points for this purchase.

market.pointsHint: ArkShop points: the single currency of every shop and the player market.

playerMap.sortHint: Click to sort (ascending, descending, scan order)
playerMap.adminOnly: Scanning and the map actions require an administrator account.
playerMap.title: Player map
playerMap.subtitle: Scan a player on one map: see where they are, their structures and dinos, then act surgically.
playerMap.truncated: Snapshot truncated at 4000 objects — the map is incomplete. Narrow the target or check the server log for the exact overflow.
playerMap.mapHint: Auto-fit view, north up, UU coordinates. Click a dot to select it.
playerMap.selectHint: Click a dot on the map or a row in the list to select a target point.
playerMap.killOfflineHint: Player offline: remove the body via destroy-in-radius.
playerMap.confirmDestroy: {{what}} of this tribe within {{r}}m of the selected point. Logged with cryo blobs (dinos restorable). Proceed?
playerMap.confirmAll: EVERYTHING means structures AND dinos. Are you really sure?
playerMap.confirmKill: Kill this player's character now? Normal death: body and item cache drop where they stand.
playerMap.mapHintGps: Calibrated map: fixed square = the whole map, dots at true GPS position (axes in GPS 0..100). Click a dot to select it.
playerMap.confirmDestroyOne: Destroy "{{what}}"? Single object, identified by its actor name — neighbours are not touched. Dinos keep a cryo blob and stay restorable.
playerMap.scanLayerHint: Re-scan only this layer: the other layers stay as they were.
playerMap.toggleLayer: Show or hide this layer on the map
playerMap.zoomHint: Scroll to zoom, drag to pan.
playerMap.noCalibration: {{map}} has no GPS calibration yet, so positions are relative and no background is drawn. It appears as soon as a server running this map boots with plugin 5.7.0+.
playerMap.sameMapUnattributed: Another active server also runs {{map}}, and this scan left no rows that can only belong to the selected server. The map stays empty so no action can hit the other server's tribe. If the player has anything on this server, run the full scan again.
playerMap.loadFailed: The player and server lists could not be loaded.
playerMap.pickPlayerHint: Search by name or EOS id, then pick a player.
playerMap.emptyHint: Pick a player and a server, then run a scan.

clusterSync.title: Cluster sync
clusterSync.subtitle: ARK moves transfers as files on disk. If the hosts of a cluster stop seeing the same directory, uploads keep succeeding and never arrive.
clusterSync.empty: No instance has a cluster id set, so there is nothing to compare.

syncthing.copyIdFor: Copy the Syncthing device ID of {{machine}}

clusterSync.hintTitle: If a host shows the wrong folder
clusterSync.hintBody: ARK appends clusters/<ClusterID> to -ClusterDirOverride itself. Point the replication at the directory shown in this table, or at its parent - never one level higher up the tree, or you get a plausible-looking directory that no server ever writes to.

hardening.title: Windows hardening
hardening.subtitle: An ARK host is a public game server: UDP ports face the internet and it is administered over SSH. These controls shrink that surface.
hardening.noNativeHint: Hardening applies to hosts with the native Windows runtime. A POK host runs its game servers inside Linux containers, where these controls do not apply.
hardening.notRunYet: Run an audit to see the current posture. Nothing on the host is changed.
hardening.machinesError: Could not load the machine list.
hardening.auditError: The audit could not be completed.
hardening.applyError: The controls could not be applied.
hardening.lockoutPending: {{count}} failing control(s) can cut administrative access and need an explicit opt-in
hardening.adminOnly: Applying controls requires an administrator account. You can run the audit from any role.
hardening.riskyWarning: Lockout-risk controls can cut your access to this host. The script still refuses the structurally unsafe cases, but verify you have a second way in before applying.
hardening.confirmRisky: You are about to apply {{count}} control(s) that can cut administrative access to this host: {{names}}. Make sure you have another way in. Continue?

applied.skipped: Skipped: tick the opt-in above to apply this one.

hardening.applyDone: {{count}} control(s) applied. The report below is a fresh audit.
hardening.selectFailingHint: {{count}} failing control(s) can be applied with the current options.
